title: The Office (US)
note: Written by Claude for Watch Together. Moments are approximate (fraction of the runtime, in scene order).

cue: im not superstitious but i am a little stitious
items.fact: 'I'm not superstitious, but I am a little stitious' - one of the most-quoted Michael lines of the whole series.
'The machine knows!' - Michael trusts the GPS over his own eyes and Dwight's screaming. One of the show's most quoted scenes.
Oscar explains that you can't just declare bankruptcy by shouting it - the scene is a fan favourite and a much-used meme.
Second Life was a real online world, huge in 2007 - and inside it Dwight plays a game called 'Second Second Life'.
'Adapt, react, readapt, apt' - Michael's survival motto, one of his best mangled phrases.
Jan's candle business 'Serenity by Jan' is why the condo smells so strong - she's spending Michael's money on it.
'Snip snap, snip snap' - Michael has had three vasectomies (and reversals). The episode is regularly ranked among the best of the whole series.
'That One Night' was written for the show as Hunter's song - and Jan plays it to wind Michael up.
Toby's knee touch and 'I'm moving to Costa Rica' set up his exit at the end of the season - this episode was written by Mindy Kaling.
Leslie David Baker's 'Did I stutter?' gave the episode its title - a rare moment of Stanley openly defying Michael.

cue: no god no god please no
items.fact: Michael's 'No, God! No, God, please, no!' when Toby returns became one of the internet's most-used reaction clips.
Princess Unicorn is a nod to real holiday toy crazes like Tickle Me Elmo - Dwight corners the market and resells them.

cue: today smoking is going to save lives
smoking is going to save lives
items.fact: This cold open aired right after Super Bowl XLIII and is regularly named the best cold open in the show.
'Stayin' Alive' really is the beat first-aid trainers use for chest compressions - about 100 beats a minute.
Charles Miner is Idris Elba, between The Wire and Luther - Michael's worst nightmare of a boss.
